evidencePolicy.scope: All direct GameAction.* calls in each unique Lua module are enumerated. The Story subset is a bounded allowlist of native playback entry points.
evidencePolicy.literalResolution: Direct quoted arguments and simple local string assignments are resolved. A simple Tables.<name> row field is also resolved when the current original table has exactly one non-empty candidate; multi-row fields, function parameters, concatenation, and general control flow remain unresolved. Calls accepting the binary-proven cinematic queue handle are classified as one runtime dispatcher family, not as unresolved authored Story references.
evidencePolicy.case: Exact registry spelling is proven separately from a case-folded candidate. A case mismatch is never promoted to a Story binding.
evidencePolicy.ownership: A Lua call proves that the controller owns playback. It creates no mission/quest attachment unless the same consumed route carries an exact mission or quest identity.
evidencePolicy.nearbyTables: Table names within a bounded source window are triage hints, not data-flow proof.
